rationale: Per Maudsley 15th edition (Schizophrenia chapter, p.216–217). Female non-smokers have the lowest CYP1A2-mediated clozapine clearance, so the target maintenance dose is 225 mg/day — the lowest of the four pharmacokinetic variants. The schedule is gentle: 6.25 mg evening for the first two days, slow build-up over 20 days. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

steps.notes: First test dose 6.25 mg evening. Lying and standing BP at 1, 2 and 4 hours post-dose. Pulse and temperature 4-hourly.
Continue 6.25 mg evening only. Repeat lying/standing BP morning, post-dose × 3.
Begin BD dosing. BP monitoring continues.
Watch for postural drop. Counsel about hypersalivation and constipation.
Start prophylactic laxative if not already (constipation is universal).
Watch for sedation, weight gain trajectory.
Reassess myocarditis warning signs (chest pain, palpitations, fever, dyspnoea).
Hold and reassess if any concerns.
Maintenance target reached. Continue with weekly FBC, troponin/CRP at weeks 2 and 4.

postTitrationGuidance: Maintain at 225 mg/day. Plasma level optimisation may follow once stable (target 350–600 ng/mL). Weekly FBC for first 18 weeks, then fortnightly for weeks 19–52, then monthly indefinitely. Faster titrations may be appropriate in younger patients without prominent dose-related side effects, particularly when cross-tapering from a previous antipsychotic.
missedDoseRule: Doses missed for more than 48 hours mandate retitration. Use the Interruption Restart Wizard for the appropriate restart strategy. Restarting at the previous dose after a gap can cause severe hypotension and cardiovascular collapse.
